description: get_next_segment returns :end_of_keyspace at materializer-less gaps even when later segments exist (find_first_segment_at_boundary requires exact segment_start == boundary), while get_previous_segment walks back across gaps. Repro: shards %{"d" => {1,"a"}, "m" => {2,"h"}}, get_next_segment(index, "b") -> :end_of_keyspace despite {h,m}. Decide semantics, make pair symmetric, update characterization test at layout_index_test.exs:191. Related: lookup_range/get_next_segment/get_previous_segment currently have zero lib callers — wire up or remove.
title: LayoutIndex get_next_segment stops at gaps; asymmetric with get_previous_segment
